The Listing Compliance Department 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited – Emerge Platform (SME Segment)

Symbol: TECHD    |    Series: SME         
Subject: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – Receipt of three (3) 
Purchase Orders aggregating INR 1,40,54,756.98/- (inclusive of GST) in the ordinary course of 
business. 
Reference: SEBI Master Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/PoD2/CIR/P/0155 dated 11 November 2024 read 
with Para B of Part A of Schedule III to the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 and the Company’s Policy 
for Determination of Materiality of Events / Information. 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para B of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to intimate that TechD Cybersecurity Limited 
(“the Company”) has received three (3) separate Purchase Orders from a Listed Cybersecurity System 
Integrator / Distribution Partner of the Company, in the ordinary course of business, for the supply of 
OEM Support / Managed Services. Aggregate Order Value is  INR 1,19,10,811/-  (excl. GST)   |   INR 
1,40,54,756.98/-  (incl. GST) 
The end-managed services beneficiaries are situated in the (i) automobile manufacturing, (ii) 
financial-sector technology services and (iii) public-sector general insurance verticals. Detailed 
particulars in the SEBI-prescribed format are set out in Annexure A, Annexure B and Annexure C 
enclosed herewith.
